method.exact: SHA256 of recursively resolved source raster, not SVG wrapper or lettering hash
method.near: 64-bit dHash <=6 Hamming, exact matches excluded; candidate flags require human confirmation, not identity or pose proof
method.pixel: 256x256 grayscale thumbnail, thresholds dark<48, mid48..143, edge>24. Resizing changes frequencies; dark/midrange and density are diagnostics, not beauty measures. Same algorithm for all sources.
method.scope: All source-panel positions in three longform experiments, premium benchmark/52-panel manifests and four accepted-for-internal-research legacy kitchen panels. Further legacy mechanisms inventoried separately; no inference of complete lifetime output count.
